# Python-produced golden fixtures

These files were generated by actually running the Python `claude-swap`
(v0.22.0b1, cloned from https://github.com/realiti4/claude-swap) from source
on Linux against a throwaway `$HOME`, on 2026-07-17. They are the
data-compatibility contract for the Go port: golden tests read them to prove
the Go implementation parses and (where applicable) round-trips what the
Python tool wrote. Do not hand-edit.

Generation (no network needed; the fake tokens produce http-401 usage errors,
which is itself useful state):

```
run() { HOME="$FIXHOME" XDG_DATA_HOME="$FIXHOME/.local/share" \
        PYTHONPATH="src:$SHIM" python3 -m claude_swap "$@"; }
run add-token sk-ant-oat01-AAAAfixture… --email alice@example.com   # slot 1
run add-token sk-ant-oat01-BBBBfixture… --email bob@example.com     # slot 2
run add-token sk-ant-api03-CCCCfixture… --email key@example.com     # slot 3 (API key)
run add-token sk-ant-oat01-DDDDfixture… --email carol@example.com --slot 5
run alias 2 dev
run disable 5
run map 2 "$FIXHOME/work/client-app"
run config set autoswitch.threshold 80
run config set autoswitch.model Fable
run switch 2
run switch 1
run export "$FIXHOME/backup-all.cswap"
run export "$FIXHOME/backup-acct2.cswap" --account 2
```

(`$SHIM` holds a fake `claude_swap-0.22.0b1.dist-info/METADATA` so
`importlib.metadata.version()` resolves outside an installed environment.)

Layout:

- `claude-swap-data/` — the backup root (`$XDG_DATA_HOME/claude-swap`) as the
  Python tool left it: `sequence.json` (slots 1,2,3,5; alias on 2; `kind:
  "api_key"` on 3; `disabled: true` on 5 — note optional keys are ABSENT on
  the other records, which is load-bearing), `configs/`, `credentials/*.enc`
  (base64), `mappings.json`, `settings.json`, `claude-swap.log` (the exact
  `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS,mmm - LEVEL - message` format incl. `Switched from
  account 2 to 1`), and `cache/usage.json` (schemaVersion 2 with http-401
  error records) + `cache/update_check.json`. The runtime lock artifacts
  (`.lock`, `cache/.usage.lock`) were removed.
- `claude-home/dot-claude.json`, `claude-home/dot-credentials.json` — what the
  Python tool wrote into the fake Claude Code home (`~/.claude.json` after
  `switch 1`, `~/.claude/.credentials.json` holding alice's token blob). Note
  `oauthAccount` org fields are JSON `null` here while `sequence.json` records
  use `""` — a deliberate asymmetry the port must preserve.
- `backup-all.cswap`, `backup-acct2.cswap` — export files (all accounts / one
  account). Import tests must accept these byte-for-byte.

`mappings.json` contains an absolute path under the generation-time scratch
`$FIXHOME`; tests should treat the path as opaque. No `.migrations.json`
exists because no registry migration applies on a fresh Linux install.

`cache/usage.json` `backoffUntil`/`lastAttemptAt` are epoch-second floats from
generation time; tests must inject a fake clock rather than compare against
wall-now.
